application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
1. Wild Cherry - Initiate new Pollard regime at 4 metres from ground level - ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - 1. 16x9m down to 4m works to allow light in to property

2. Oak - Remove low crossing branch and crown lift remainder by approximately 1 metre to balance - ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - 2. 12x8m lifting works to clear building

3. Oak - Tip thin by up to 20% following previous reduction works  - ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - 3. 12x8m works to reduce the density of the crown to allow dappled light through the canopy

4. Holly - Reduce height to 2 metres tall to reform the hedge  - ADDITIONAL INFORMATION -  4. 7x6m down to 2x6m works to reform an over grown hedge

5. Norway Maple - Crown lift by removal of first three 4'' diameter branches  - ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - 5. 18x10 works to balance crown following the removal of branch’s for new phone cables
